articles.title: AI contracts, not bitcoin, now drive miner valuations, and Cipher and TeraWulf look cheap, says analyst
articles.snippet: Compass Point analysts Michael Donovan and Ed Engel said markets are giving little credit to future AI data center pipelines despite billions of dollars in signed leases.

articles.title: A trader turns $800 into over $1 million on Robinhood's brand new blockchain betting on memecoin
articles.snippet: Robinhood's blockchain went live on July 1 to move stocks onchain. Its first breakout hit is a memecoin named after the mascot the company abandoned.

articles.title: Sony Bank gets US regulator nod to issue stablecoins
articles.snippet: Sony Bank received preliminary approval from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency to establish a US stablecoin issuance business, with $40 million in starting capital.

articles.title: AI boom fuels inflation fears, complicating Fed’s next rate move
articles.snippet: Ongoing strong demand for AI infrastructure “would likely sustain upward pressure on prices for technology products and electricity,” Federal Reserve policymakers said.

articles.title: Tokenized stock transfers surge 105% in a month to $8.4B
articles.snippet: Industry data shows trading activity and market value accelerating as crypto companies and traditional financial institutions expand tokenized equity initiatives.
